routes.name: Global Citizen Concierge Programme
routes.summary: Lets remote workers for a non-Cayman employer live in the Cayman Islands for up to two years. Figures below come from the 2020 launch page and may be outdated.

income.note: Single applicant. 150,000 with a spouse, 180,000 with dependent children.

other: Letter from a non-Cayman employer with position and salary.
Notarized bank reference, health insurance, police clearance.
Children must attend a local private school or be homeschooled.
Figures from the 2020 launch page. Check the current WORC page.

stay.note: Up to two years with a Global Citizen Certificate.

fees.label: Per year, up to two persons (2020 launch page)
Per dependent per year (2020 launch page)

sources.label: Visit Cayman Islands, Global Citizen Concierge launch

routes.name: Work permit (WORC)
routes.summary: Employer-sponsored permit. New permit holders from 1 May 2026 generally can't change employers for 2 years.

other: Employer must advertise the job for 21 days (14 days if applied by 21 May 2026).
Dependants need CI$5,000 monthly income for the first, plus CI$1,000 for each extra.

fees.label: Annual work permit grant fee, by tier (CI$150, 250 or 500)
fees.note: Tiers are CI$150, CI$250 or CI$500

routes.name: Residency Certificate for Persons of Independent Means
routes.summary: Residency for people with independent means. Held for 10 years and can lead to permanent residence for those who invested in developed real estate. Income and investment minimums not confirmed.

other: Income and real estate minimums were not stated in the source read. Check WORC.

fees.label: Per dependant, plus the same each year

routes.name: Certificate of Direct Investment
routes.summary: Residency tied to a direct investment in the Cayman Islands. The investment threshold was not stated in the source read.

other: Investment threshold not confirmed. Check WORC.

fees.label: Per dependant, plus the same each year

routes.name: Residency Certificate (Substantial Business Presence)
routes.summary: Residency for people linked to a substantial business presence in the Cayman Islands. Qualifying criteria not confirmed.

other: Qualifying criteria not stated in the source read. Check WORC.

fees.label: Per dependant, plus the same each year

routes.name: Permanent residence (RERC, 8 years)
routes.summary: Residency and Employment Rights Certificate for people legally and ordinarily resident for at least 8 years. The points system also exists but wasn't covered by the source read.

other: At least 8 years legal and ordinary residence.
Points-based framework unchanged per MCEI but details not confirmed.

fees.label: Fee by work permit fee tier (CI$1,500, 2,500 or 5,000)
fees.note: Tiers are CI$1,500, CI$2,500 or CI$5,000

routes.name: RERC for spouse of a Caymanian or permanent resident
routes.summary: Residency for spouses or civil partners of Caymanians or permanent residents. Annual declaration required. Wait for naturalization rose to 15 years.

other: If the spouse dies: under 7 years of marriage the RERC is lost, 7 to under 15 years is discretionary.

routes.name: Caymanian status
routes.summary: Right to be Caymanian. Naturalized people need 20 years of residence, or 10 years after a naturalization or registration certificate. Married to a Caymanian: 15 years under the new rules.

other: Source pages differ slightly on some marriage periods, so confirm with WORC.

citizenship.note: Marriage route is 15 years under new rules. Born in the Islands on or before 26 March 1977 is Caymanian as of right.
